sql:
SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team_Attributes TA
JOIN Team T ON TA.team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE TA.date LIKE '2012-%' AND TA.buildUpPlayPassing > (
    SELECT AVG(TA2.buildUpPlayPassing)
    FROM Team_Attributes TA2
    WHERE TA2.date LIKE '2012-%'
)
GROUP BY T.team_long_name
